item.description: Team India will enter the T20 World Cup 2026 as a formidable contender to retain their title. item.title: “Biggest strength is swinging the new ball”: Rohit Sharma expects Arshdeep Singh to hold key for India at T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: As the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 draws closer, former India skipper Rohit Sharma explained why the left-arm pacer Arshdeep Singh will hold a key for the defending champions in the global tournament. According to Rohit, Arshdeep’s biggest strength is swinging the new ball and taking early wickets, and it will help India immensely. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “We had decided…,” Suryakumar Yadav explains why Ishan Kishan kept wickets over Sanju Samson in 5th T20I
item.description: India skipper Suryakumar Yadav clarified that Ishan Kishan keeping wickets over Sanju Samson during the fifth T20I against New Zealand in Thiruvananthapuram on Saturday (January 31) was planned even before the series got underway. item.description: Indian footballer Gurpreet Singh Sandhu poked fun at Pakistani cricketers Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan in a viral training clip shared on social media. item.title: Pakistan to forfeit Group A match against India at T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Pakistan will forfeit their scheduled Group A match against India at the T20 World Cup 2026, slated to start on February 7. A post issued by the Government of Pakistan's official X account confirmed that the Pakistan team will travel to Sri Lanka for the global tournament. However, it added that "the Pakistan cricket team shall not take the field in the match scheduled on 15 February 2026 against India".
